action: Deliver the Howard Liu AV literacy and EV diagnostics workshop. Frank shows up to Liu's parts store, runs the two-hour session with his prepared curriculum, and collects the agreed fee of $500. He teaches professionally -- not as a favor, not apologetically. He documents the session with a one-paragraph write-up and asks Howard for a brief testimonial he can use when pitching future corporate workshops.
